scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:shared && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python3.13 -m venv venv && venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:shared: npm --prefix shared ci && npm --prefix shared run build
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:frontend
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build:frontend
